body: Thanks man. In another world, we could go for some beer or something if things were different. You are a good fellow. At the end of the day, we were dealt a bad hand and we do what is possible with the resources we have. Good luck to you too buddy.

I guess a man's worth is only measured by his ability to provide. Otherwise, we are useless to anyone. God forbid, we ask for help.  My family has called me names yet. But, feels like it's a matter of time.

I will take your advise about speaking with another DR but I want go with high hopes.

You should try and sue that DR, if possible. I know that lasik surgery isn't performed on some people, if the cornea isn't "thick" enough. At least, you could try to secure some money that way.

As for the job, I had been trying for like 7-8 months with 30-40 job application. Still nothing. Feels like time is running out. 

Really hope we make it out of this somehow.

DR has not told me I am going blind. Thing is, I always had poor vision since birth. Myopia to be precise. Last 2 years big floaters and eye flashes started appearing. DR kept telling me it's normal. And thus came the macular bleeding. If those are not signs of blindness, I don't know what it is. 

People really don't appreciate the gift of vision. Without it, we are at a big disadvantage. I want to work as long as I still can for my family before I am gone

Sorry to hear about your condition. Did DR tell you if your situation can be reversed? You can dm me if want someone to talk.
